title: CODEX® Multiplexed Imaging | Tissue Sectioning
author: Diane Saunders
materials: Gather reagents: Poly-l-lysine, 0.1% (wt/vol) Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #P8920 22 x 22m Glass Cover Slips # 1 1/2 Electron Microscopy Sciences Catalog #72204-01
Slowly pipet off the poly-L-lysine solution and dispose.

steps.title: Coat coverslips with poly‑L‑lysine
steps.instruction: Prepare poly‑L‑lysine‑coated coverslips in a 500 mL glass beaker.

substeps.instruction: Place coverslips at the bottom of the beaker and swirl to spread them out.
Add approximately 20 mL poly‑L‑lysine solution, ensuring all coverslips are fully submerged.
Rotate the beaker at a 45° angle for 00:01:00 (1 minute) to mix.
Cover the beaker with parafilm and incubate at room temperature for a minimum of 12:00:00 (12 hours); coated coverslips may remain in the solution for up to one week.

steps.title: Wash coated coverslips
steps.instruction: Rinse the poly‑L‑lysine‑coated coverslips with Milli‑Q water.

substeps.instruction: Fill the beaker containing the coverslips to half volume with Milli‑Q® water.
Swirl gently, let sit for 00:00:30 (30 seconds), then slowly pour off the water into the sink.
Repeat the wash for a total of 5–7 washes.

steps.title: Dry coated coverslips
steps.instruction: Remove excess liquid and air‑dry the coverslips.

substeps.instruction: Spread WypAll® towels on the benchtop.
In small batches, remove coverslips from the beaker, separate them, and place individual coverslips side‑by‑side on the towels.
Layer another towel on top and gently dab to remove excess liquid.
Leave the coverslips on the benchtop until completely dry; they can be stored in a petri dish for up to 2 months.

steps.title: Prepare cryostat
steps.instruction: Set up the cryostat for sectioning.

substeps.instruction: Set the cryostat temperature to –20 °C.
Remove a fresh blade, clean it with ethanol and a lint‑free wipe as needed, and insert the blade.

steps.title: Mount tissue in OCT/CMC
steps.instruction: Mount the tissue block on the cryostat chuck and trim the embedding medium.

substeps.instruction: Using OCT or CMC, mount the sample onto the cryostat chuck in the desired orientation.
Trim the CMC using larger section increments of 30–50 µm until the tissue becomes visible.

steps.title: Section tissue onto coverslips
steps.instruction: Obtain thin sections and place them on the coated coverslips.

substeps.instruction: Obtain 6 µm to 10 µm sections.
Using a fine‑tipped paintbrush, guide each section onto the base and place the coated coverslip onto the section.

steps.title: Load coverslips into holder
steps.instruction: Place the mounted coverslips into a plastic holder and label them.

substeps.instruction: Using forceps, slot each coverslip with mounted tissue into a plastic coverslip holder.
Attach the appropriate donor/block ID label(s) to the holder.

steps.title: Store prepared slides
steps.instruction: Freeze the prepared coverslips for long‑term storage.

substeps.instruction: Store the coverslips at –80 °C for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Optional adjacent slide preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare additional sections on alternative slides if needed.

substeps.instruction: Mount adjacent sections onto Gold Plus slides for traditional immunohistochemistry or onto ITO slides for mass spectrometry.
Record all sections cut, their thickness, and any additional block shaved off during the process.
